verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of an official Kick SDK: the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, and the only MCP endpoint found (kick-probe-3) is GitBook's generic docs-search MCP server, not a Kick-built API/SDK — it serves documentation, not account or ledger data. AI workflows are routed indirectly through Google Sheets exports rather than a programmable SDK.
